description: This file contains bash shell script functions used for managing artifacts, file path classifications, git worktrees, and CI/CD workflows in a project.

methods.name: require_artifact
methods.description: Checks if a required artifact file exists and is non-empty, outputs an error and exits if not.

methods.name: path_is_docsish
methods.description: Determines if a given path likely points to documentation files based on its filename or directory.

methods.name: path_is_testish
methods.description: Checks if a given path resembles test files or directories.

methods.name: path_is_maintainer_workflow_only
methods.description: Identifies paths used for maintainer workflows or scripts, not part of the main codebase.

methods.name: file_list_is_docsish_only
methods.description: Checks if a list of files contains only documentation-related files.

methods.name: changelog_required_for_changed_files
methods.description: Determines if a changelog should be generated based on the list of changed files.

methods.name: print_review_stdout_summary
methods.description: Outputs a formatted summary of the review, including recommendations and findings.

methods.name: print_relevant_log_excerpt
methods.description: Displays relevant log lines filtered for errors or shows the last lines of the log.

methods.name: print_unrelated_gate_failure_guidance
methods.description: Provides guidance for unrelated CI gate failures based on the failure label.

methods.name: run_quiet_logged
methods.description: Runs a command, logs output, and reports success or failure with additional log info.

methods.name: bootstrap_deps_if_needed
methods.description: Installs dependencies if specific binaries are missing.

methods.name: wait_for_pr_head_sha
methods.description: Polls for a PR's head SHA to match an expected value, with retries.

methods.name: is_author_email_merge_error
methods.description: Detects if a message indicates an author email merge error.

methods.name: merge_author_email_candidates
methods.description: Generates a list of candidate emails for merge author identity.

methods.name: common_repo_root
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the repository.

methods.name: worktree_path_for_branch
methods.description: Gets the path of a worktree for a specified branch.

methods.name: worktree_is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is registered in the repo for a given path.

methods.name: resolve_existing_dir_path
methods.description: Resolves an existing directory path, following symlinks.

methods.name: is_repo_pr_worktree_dir
methods.description: Determines if a directory is a recognized PR worktree.

methods.name: remove_worktree_if_present
methods.description: Removes a worktree at a given path if present, using git or trash.

methods.name: delete_local_branch_if_safe
methods.description: Deletes a local branch if it is safe to do so (not checked out, exists).
